title: Curso Aprendizaje Profundo (Datitos, Mendoza)
notes: Site of an Argentine course built on D2L (2021 and 2022 editions); not a translation and no parallel English. About 1,600 words of human-written Argentine Spanish (voseo): syllabus by unit (web/2022/01_CONTENIDOS.md, identical to 2021), 2021 class schedule (README.md), assignments (Trabajos.md, ProyectosFinales.md) and the markdown cells of tp2/Trabajo práctico 2.ipynb. Schedule rows are terse and keep many English loanwords; a few typos. No licence file.
